verdict.rationale: Firecrawl clearly runs versioned APIs: endpoints are path-versioned (`/v2/parse`), and the docs index keeps separate v2 and v1 documentation sets. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or migration guarantee. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, v1-to-v2 migration guidance, changelog or version-support commitments, and independent corroboration.
